name: Sakhile
bio: Sakhile grew up here. He ran a spaza, then a bakkie hire, then a small logistics outfit that does well enough that people have started asking him for things. He is resourceful, he is impatient, and he believes — genuinely, not as a pitch — that this place can work if enough people pull in the same direction. He is also the only developer in this story who will still be living here in eighteen years.
_note: DECISIONS D12. Being local is mechanical, not decorative: it sets the opening relationships (high with the people who know him, low with the institutions that lend money), it sets the low opening cash, and it is why the extraction ending and the sports field both cut deeper for Sakhile than they would for an outsider.
